result.fix: Raise the MTU of `eth0` and of the switch ports it connects to, to 1500 or more. Set it in your network configuration (netplan, NetworkManager or the ifcfg files) so it survives a reboot. If the network cannot carry that, set the CNI MTU to 1400 or less and ask the vendor if 1400 is enough.
result.message: `eth0` has MTU 1450 and VXLAN needs 50 bytes, so the pod network must use 1400 or less, and 1450 is needed.
